<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Esseigma POS AI — Aplikasi Kasir & POS Digital untuk UMKM Indonesia</title>
<meta name="description" content="Esseigma POS AI adalah aplikasi kasir & POS digital untuk warung, toko kelontong, dan usaha kuliner. Kelola penjualan, stok, cashflow, tagihan, karyawan, sampai analitik laba — dibantu Esseigma AI." />
<meta name="theme-color" content="#003884" />
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64," />
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="logo.png" />

<!-- Open Graph -->
<meta property="og:title" content="Esseigma POS AI — POS Digital untuk UMKM" />
<meta property="og:description" content="Satu aplikasi untuk kasir, stok, cashflow, dan tagihan. Ditemani asisten Esseigma AI." />
<meta property="og:image" content="logo.png" />
<meta property="og:type" content="website" />

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;0,800;1,600&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />

<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#003884;
    --navy-deep:#002460;
    --sky:#C2D7FF;
    --sky-soft:#E4ECF9;
    --paper:#F6F9FE;
    --ink:#141b2e;
    --sub:#5b6b81;
    --line:#dce6f5;
    --gold:#E9B10A;
    --gold-soft:#FDF3D0;
    --green:#1f9d57;
    --red:#e23b34;
    --frame:#101012;
    --white:#ffffff;

    --display:"Playfair Display",Georgia,serif;
    --body:"Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
    --mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;

    --shadow-s:0 2px 8px rgba(0,32,90,.06);
    --shadow-m:0 12px 30px rgba(0,32,90,.10);
    --shadow-l:0 30px 70px rgba(0,32,90,.18);
    --r:18px;
    --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);
    --wrap:1180px;
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:var(--body);
    color:var(--ink);
    background:var(--paper);
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  h1,h2,h3{margin:0;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.01em}
  p{margin:0}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
  img,svg{display:block}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}

  .eyebrow{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:.72rem;
    letter-spacing:.22em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--navy);
    font-weight:600;
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6em;
  }
  .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:22px;height:1.5px;background:var(--navy);opacity:.5}
  .serif{font-family:var(--display)}

  /* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5em;
    font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;
    padding:.85em 1.5em;border-radius:100px;border:1.5px solid transparent;
    cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s var(--ease),box-shadow .2s var(--ease),background .2s;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .btn-primary{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,56,132,.28)}
  .btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(0,56,132,.36)}
  .btn-ghost{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line)}
  .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--navy);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:#3a2c00;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(233,177,10,.35)}
  .btn-gold:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(233,177,10,.45)}
  :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  header.nav{
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;
    backdrop-filter:saturate(160%) blur(14px);
    background:rgba(246,249,254,.82);
    border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
    transition:border-color .3s, background .3s;
  }
  header.nav.scrolled{border-color:var(--line);background:rgba(246,249,254,.94)}
  .nav-in{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:70px}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.55em;font-weight:800;font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:-.02em}
  .brand-logo{width:38px;height:38px;object-fit:contain;display:block}
  .brand-chip{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:5px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-s)}
  .brand-chip img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
  .nav-links{display:flex;gap:2rem;align-items:center}
  .nav-links a{font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--sub);transition:color .2s}
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--navy)}
  .nav-cta{display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:center}
  .burger{display:none;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:8px}
  .burger span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;background:var(--ink);margin:4px 0;transition:.3s}

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero{position:relative;padding:72px 0 90px;overflow:hidden}
  .hero::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;
    background:
      radial-gradient(120% 90% at 85% -10%, var(--sky) 0%, rgba(194,215,255,0) 55%),
      linear-gradient(180deg,#EAF1FC 0%, var(--paper) 60%);
  }
  .hero::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;opacity:.5;
    background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(0,56,132,.10) 1px, transparent 0);
    background-size:26px 26px;
    -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0%,transparent 70%);
    mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0%,transparent 70%);
  }
  .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
  .hero-tag{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6em;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:.4em .9em .4em .5em;border-radius:100px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--sub);
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-s);margin-bottom:24px;
  }
  .hero-tag b{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:.2em .7em;border-radius:100px;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.02em}
  .hero h1{
    font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;
    font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5.6vw,4.15rem);letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--ink);
  }
  .hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--navy)}
  .hero .lead{font-size:1.12rem;color:var(--sub);margin-top:22px;max-width:33ch}
  .hero-cta{display:flex;gap:.8rem;margin-top:32px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .trust{display:flex;gap:1.4rem;margin-top:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600}
  .trust span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.45em}
  .trust svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--green)}

  /* animated reveal */
  .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .7s var(--ease),transform .7s var(--ease)}
  .reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

  /* ---------- Phone mockup ---------- */
  .phone-stage{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:center;perspective:1600px}
  .glow{
    position:absolute;width:320px;height:320px;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,56,132,.28),transparent 65%);
    filter:blur(30px);top:40%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:0;
  }
  .phone{
    position:relative;z-index:2;width:300px;
    background:var(--frame);border-radius:44px;padding:12px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-l), inset 0 0 0 2px #2a2a30;
    animation:float 7s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotateX(2deg) rotateY(-4deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-14px) rotateX(2deg) rotateY(-4deg)}}
  .screen{
    position:relative;border-radius:34px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--sky) 0%,var(--sky-soft) 22%,#fff 55%);
    height:600px;
  }
  .statusbar{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 22px 4px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy-deep)}
  .statusbar .island{position:absolute;left:50%;top:12px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:78px;height:21px;background:var(--frame);border-radius:100px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
  .statusbar .island::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#1c2740;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(120,150,210,.4)}
  .statusbar .stat{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
  .statusbar .stat svg{height:11px;width:auto;display:block;color:var(--navy-deep)}
  .app-head{
    margin:8px 12px 0;border-radius:18px;color:#fff;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),#004aa8);
    padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(0,56,132,.28);
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  }
  .app-head .store-ava{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem}
  .app-head .store-name{font-weight:800;font-size:.92rem;letter-spacing:.01em}
  .app-head .store-id{font-size:.66rem;opacity:.75;font-family:var(--mono)}
  .bell{margin-left:auto;position:relative}
  .bell::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--navy)}

  .greet{padding:12px 16px 2px;text-align:right}
  .greet .hi{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:1.02rem;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.15}
  .greet .date{font-size:.64rem;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}

  .sales-card{margin:10px 12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:13px 14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-s);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
  .sales-card .st{flex:1;min-width:0}
  .sales-card .lbl{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);text-transform:uppercase}
  .sales-card .amt{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--navy-deep);margin-top:2px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink);display:inline-block;line-height:1.35}
  .sales-card .subl{font-size:.63rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--sub);margin-top:6px}
  .sales-card .subl b{color:var(--green);border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--green)}
  .sales-card .txl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-top:5px}
  .sales-card .txl svg{width:13px;height:13px;color:var(--navy)}
  .arrow-up{flex:none;width:54px;height:50px}

  .menu-grid{margin:2px 12px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:4px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:12px 6px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-s)}
  .menu-item{text-align:center;font-size:.48rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--sub);line-height:1.2}
  .menu-item .ic{width:29px;height:29px;margin:0 auto 5px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--sky-soft);color:var(--navy)}
  .menu-item .ic svg{width:16px;height:16px}
  .menu-item.ai .ic{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6a2fd6,#a45cff);color:#fff}
  .menu-item.g1 .ic{background:#fdeecf;color:#c98a12}
  .menu-item.g2 .ic{background:#e6f6ee;color:var(--green)}
  .menu-item.g3 .ic{background:#fdeceb;color:var(--red)}

  .stok-ok{margin:10px 12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:13px 14px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-s)}
  .stok-ok .wt{font-size:.61rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;color:var(--ink);text-transform:uppercase;text-align:left}
  .stok-ok .chk{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;margin:10px auto 7px}
  .stok-ok .chk svg{width:20px;height:20px;color:#fff}
  .stok-ok .ok{font-size:.65rem;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600}

  .add-btn{margin:8px 12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),#004aa8);color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:12px;text-align:center;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.03em;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(0,56,132,.28);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px}

  .botnav{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-around;padding:9px 0 14px}
  .botnav div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:.55rem;font-weight:700;color:#aab6c8}
  .botnav div svg{width:19px;height:19px}
  .botnav div.on{color:var(--navy)}

  .phone-wrap{position:relative;width:300px}
  /* floating badges near phone */
  .fbadge{position:absolute;z-index:4;width:158px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 13px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-m);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700}
  .fbadge small{display:block;font-size:.62rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--sub)}
  .fbadge .bic{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;flex:none}
  .fb1{top:58px;left:-116px;animation:float 6s ease-in-out infinite}
  .fb2{bottom:96px;right:-116px;animation:float 6.5s .5s ease-in-out infinite}

  /* ---------- generic section ---------- */
  section{position:relative}
  .sec{padding:96px 0}
  .sec-head{max-width:640px;margin-bottom:52px}
  .sec-head h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.6vw,2.9rem);margin-top:16px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
  .sec-head p{color:var(--sub);font-size:1.05rem;margin-top:16px}

  /* ---------- audience strip ---------- */
  .audience{background:var(--navy-deep);color:#fff;padding:34px 0}
  .aud-in{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:36px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
  .aud-in .lbl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sky);opacity:.85}
  .aud-tags{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
  .aud-tags span{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:100px;padding:.45em 1.1em;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;color:#e7eefb}

  /* ---------- features bento ---------- */
  .bento{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:18px}
  .tile{
    background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:24px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-s);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s;
    grid-column:span 2;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .tile:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-m);border-color:var(--sky)}
  .tile .ic{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--sky-soft);color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:16px}
  .tile .ic svg{width:23px;height:23px}
  .tile h3{font-size:1.12rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em}
  .tile p{color:var(--sub);font-size:.92rem;margin-top:8px}
  .tile .pill{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;padding:.3em .7em;border-radius:100px;background:var(--gold-soft);color:#8a6400;border:1px solid #f0dca0}

  /* AI big tile */
  .tile.ai{
    grid-column:span 3;grid-row:span 1;color:#fff;border:0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(120% 130% at 90% 10%, #7b3ff2 0%, transparent 55%),
      linear-gradient(140deg,#1c1145,#3a1e8a);
  }
  .tile.ai .ic{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff}
  .tile.ai p{color:#cfc2f2}
  .tile.ai .chatline{margin-top:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:.82rem;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start}
  .tile.ai .chatline .who{font-size:.6rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#b39cff;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:2px}
  .tile.wide{grid-column:span 3}

  /* ---------- Esseigma AI spotlight ---------- */
  .aispot{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#140b33,#241468 70%,#3a1e8a);color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
  .aispot::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px,transparent 0);background-size:30px 30px;opacity:.6}
  .aispot .wrap{position:relative}
  .aispot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
  .aispot .eyebrow{color:#b39cff}
  .aispot .eyebrow::before{background:#b39cff;opacity:.7}
  .aispot h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2rem,3.8vw,3rem);margin-top:16px}
  .aispot h2 em{font-style:italic;color:#c9b6ff}
  .aispot > .wrap p.big{color:#cfc4ee;font-size:1.08rem;margin-top:18px;max-width:44ch}
  .ai-feats{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:26px 0 0;display:grid;gap:14px}
  .ai-feats li{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:.96rem}
  .ai-feats li .dot{flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#c9b6ff}
  .ai-feats li .dot svg{width:14px;height:14px}
  .chatbox{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:22px;padding:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-l)}
  .chatbox .ch-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);margin-bottom:16px}
  .chatbox .ch-head .av{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6a2fd6,#a45cff);display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700}
  .chatbox .ch-head b{font-size:.95rem}
  .chatbox .ch-head small{display:block;font-size:.66rem;color:#9d8fd0;font-weight:600}
  .msg{max-width:82%;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:16px;font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.5}
  .msg.user{margin-left:auto;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4a7fce,#2a63b8);border-bottom-right-radius:5px}
  .msg.bot{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-bottom-left-radius:5px;color:#e9e4fb}
  .typing{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
  .typing i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#b39cff;animation:blink 1.2s infinite}
  .typing i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.2s}.typing i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.4s}
  @keyframes blink{0%,60%,100%{opacity:.3}30%{opacity:1}}

  /* ---------- Pricing ---------- */
  .pricing{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff, var(--paper))}
  .price-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:stretch}
  .plan{
    background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:28px;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:var(--shadow-s);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease)
  }
  .plan:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-m)}
  .plan .cap{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
  .plan h3{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:1.5rem;margin-top:6px}
  .plan .tagline{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--sub);font-style:italic;margin-top:6px;min-height:2.6em}
  .plan .price{margin:18px 0 4px}
  .plan .price .old{color:var(--red);text-decoration:line-through;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600}
  .plan .price .now{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:2rem;color:var(--ink)}
  .plan .price .per{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600}
  .plan ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:18px 0 24px;display:grid;gap:11px}
  .plan li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:.88rem;color:#34435c}
  .plan li svg{flex:none;width:17px;height:17px;margin-top:2px;color:var(--navy)}
  .plan .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:auto}
  .plan.basic{--accent:#5B6B7F}
  .plan.pro{--accent:#003884;border-color:var(--navy);box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(0,56,132,.16);transform:scale(1.02)}
  .plan.pro:hover{transform:scale(1.02) translateY(-4px)}
  .plan.elite{--accent:#7A1E2B}
  .plan .cap{color:var(--accent)}
  .plan.pro li svg{color:var(--navy)}
  .plan.elite li svg{color:#7A1E2B}
  .ribbon{align-self:flex-start;background:var(--gold);color:#3a2c00;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:.35em .9em;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:12px;text-transform:uppercase}
  .plan .intro{font-size:.74rem;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600;margin-top:6px}
  .plan .intro b{color:var(--navy)}
  .trial-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4em;align-self:flex-start;background:var(--gold-soft);color:#8a6400;border:1px solid #f0dca0;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.03em;padding:.3em .8em;border-radius:100px;margin-top:14px}
  .trial-banner{
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6em;flex-wrap:wrap;text-align:center;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff9e6,#fdf3d0);border:1px solid #f0dca0;color:#7a5800;
    border-radius:16px;padding:16px 22px;margin:0 auto 34px;max-width:660px;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-s);
  }
  .trial-banner svg{flex:none;color:var(--gold)}
  .trial-banner b{color:var(--navy)}

  /* ---------- how to start ---------- */
  .steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;counter-reset:s}
  .step{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:26px;position:relative}
  .step .num{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:2.4rem;color:var(--sky);line-height:1}
  .step h3{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:800;margin-top:10px}
  .step p{color:var(--sub);font-size:.92rem;margin-top:8px}

  /* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
  .faq{display:grid;gap:12px;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto}
  details{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:2px 20px;transition:border-color .2s}
  details[open]{border-color:var(--sky)}
  summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;padding:18px 0;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px}
  summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  summary .plus{flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);position:relative;transition:transform .3s,background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s;color:var(--navy)}
  summary .plus::before,summary .plus::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;background:currentColor;border-radius:2px}
  summary .plus::before{width:11px;height:2.2px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
  summary .plus::after{width:2.2px;height:11px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
  details[open] summary .plus{transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
  details p{color:var(--sub);padding:0 0 20px;font-size:.94rem}

  /* ---------- CTA ---------- */
  .cta-band{padding:90px 0}
  .cta-box{
    background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--navy),#00286a 60%,#001a4d);
    border-radius:32px;padding:64px 48px;text-align:center;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-l);
  }
  .cta-box::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px,rgba(255,255,255,.07) 1px,transparent 0);background-size:28px 28px}
  .cta-box .in{position:relative}
  .cta-box h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4vw,3rem)}
  .cta-box p{color:var(--sky);margin-top:16px;font-size:1.05rem}
  .cta-box .btns{display:flex;gap:.9rem;justify-content:center;margin-top:30px;flex-wrap:wrap}

  /* ---------- footer ---------- */
  footer{background:var(--navy-deep);color:#cdd8ec;padding:56px 0 30px}
  .foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px;padding-bottom:36px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
  footer .brand{color:#fff;margin-bottom:14px}
  footer .brand .mark{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
  footer p.desc{font-size:.9rem;color:#9fb0cf;max-width:36ch}
  footer h4{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7f92b5;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px}
  footer ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;gap:10px}
  footer ul a{font-size:.9rem;color:#cdd8ec;transition:color .2s}
  footer ul a:hover{color:#fff}
  .foot-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:24px;font-size:.82rem;color:#8496b8;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
  .foot-bottom .built{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.74rem}

  /* ---------- responsive ---------- */
  @media(max-width:900px){
    .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:56px}
    .phone-stage{order:-1}
    .hero .lead{max-width:none}
    .aispot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}
    .bento{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
    .tile,.tile.ai,.tile.wide{grid-column:span 2}
    .price-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:440px;margin:0 auto}
    .plan.pro{transform:none}.plan.pro:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
    .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}
    .nav-links{display:none}
    .burger{display:block}
    .nav-links.open{display:flex;position:absolute;top:70px;left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;background:#fff;padding:20px 24px;gap:1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-m)}
    .nav-links.open a{color:var(--ink)}
    .nav-cta .btn-ghost{display:none}
  }
  @media(max-width:520px){
    .sec{padding:72px 0}
    .cta-box{padding:44px 22px}
    .fbadge{display:none}
    .aud-in{gap:18px}
  }
  @media (min-width:901px) and (max-width:1199px){
    .fbadge{display:none}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    *{animation:none !important;transition:none !important;scroll-behavior:auto}
    .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
  }
</style>
</head>

<!-- ============ FEATURES ============ -->
<section class="sec" id="fitur">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <span class="eyebrow">Satu aplikasi, semua kebutuhan</span>
      <h2>Semua yang tokomu butuhkan, di satu tempat.</h2>
      <p>Dari mencatat penjualan sampai membaca laba — semuanya rapi, cepat, dan mudah dipahami tanpa perlu belajar akuntansi.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="bento">
      <div class="tile reveal">
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><circle cx="9" cy="20" r="1.4"/><circle cx="18" cy="20" r="1.4"/><path d="M2 3h3l2.4 12.3a1.5 1.5 0 0 0 1.5 1.2h8.4a1.5 1.5 0 0 0 1.5-1.2L22 7H6"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Kasir Cepat</h3>
        <p>Buat nota penjualan dalam hitungan detik, dukung scan barcode, cetak struk, atau kirim struk virtual ke pelanggan.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="tile reveal">
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M21 8 12 3 3 8l9 5 9-5Z"/><path d="M3 8v8l9 5 9-5V8"/><path d="M12 13v8"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Manajemen Stok</h3>
        <p>Pantau jumlah barang otomatis setiap transaksi, dengan peringatan saat stok mulai menipis atau habis.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="tile reveal">
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M17 3l4 4-4 4"/><path d="M21 7H8"/><path d="M7 21l-4-4 4-4"/><path d="M3 17h13"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Cashflow</h3>
        <p>Catat setiap uang masuk dan keluar supaya kamu selalu tahu ke mana perginya uang toko.</p>
      </div>

      <!-- Esseigma AI big tile -->
      <div class="tile ai reveal">
        <div class="pill" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#e8ddff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)">PRO</div>
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#fff"><path d="M12 2l1.6 4.8L18 8l-4.4 1.2L12 14l-1.6-4.8L6 8l4.4-1.2z"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Esseigma AI — asisten bisnismu</h3>
        <p>Tanya apa saja soal tokomu, minta ringkasan penjualan, atau saran menaikkan omzet. Esseigma AI paham konteks usaha kecil di Indonesia.</p>
        <div class="chatline">
          <div><div class="who">Kamu</div>Barang apa yang paling laku minggu ini?</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tile reveal">
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/><path d="M14 2v6h6"/><path d="M8 13h8M8 17h8"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Daftar Tagihan</h3>
        <p>Kelola tagihan ke sales dan supplier, lengkap dengan pengingat jatuh tempo agar tak ada yang terlewat.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="tile reveal">
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3.2"/><path d="M2 20c0-3.3 3.1-5 7-5s7 1.7 7 5"/><path d="M16 4.2a3.2 3.2 0 0 1 0 6.1"/><path d="M22 20c0-2.7-2-4.3-4.5-4.8"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Karyawan</h3>
        <p>Kelola staf toko dengan akses multi-user, sehingga usaha tetap terkontrol meski dijalankan bersama tim.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="tile reveal">
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M4 22V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h11l3 3v17"/><path d="M8 7h6M8 11h8M8 15h5"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Berita Pasar</h3>
        <p>Ikuti kabar harga sembako, komoditas, dan ekonomi yang relevan dengan usahamu — langsung dari beranda.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="tile reveal">
        <div class="pill">PRO</div>
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M3 3v18h18"/><path d="M7 15l4-5 3 3 5-7"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Analitik Laba</h3>
        <p>Lihat laba secara real-time, bukan sekadar omzet — biar keputusanmu selalu berdasar data, bukan tebakan.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="tile wide reveal">
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M7 8v8M10 8v8M13 8v8M17 8v8"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Scanner, Printer &amp; QRIS siap pakai</h3>
        <p>Dukungan scan barcode (USB/HID), cetak struk lewat Bluetooth, USB, maupun jaringan, dan pembayaran QRIS — plus keamanan PIN &amp; biometrik dan backup data. Jalan di Android maupun desktop.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ SIGMA AI SPOTLIGHT ============ -->
<section class="sec aispot" id="esseigma-ai">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="aispot-grid">
      <div class="reveal">
        <span class="eyebrow">Esseigma AI</span>
        <h2>Punya <em>penasihat bisnis</em> di dalam saku.</h2>
        <p class="big">Esseigma AI mengubah data tokomu menjadi jawaban yang jelas. Cukup tanya dengan bahasa sehari-hari, dan biarkan AI membantumu mengambil keputusan lebih cepat.</p>
        <ul class="ai-feats">
          <li><span class="dot"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg></span> Ringkas penjualan &amp; performa toko dalam sekejap</li>
          <li><span class="dot"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg></span> Saran restok dan strategi menaikkan omzet</li>
          <li><span class="dot"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg></span> Ruang obrolan tersimpan, bisa dilanjutkan kapan saja</li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div class="chatbox reveal">
        <div class="ch-head">
          <div class="av">E</div>
          <div><b>Esseigma AI</b><small>Online · siap membantu</small></div>

<script>
  // Nav shadow on scroll
  const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  addEventListener('scroll', () => nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', scrollY > 10));

  // Mobile menu
  const burger = document.getElementById('burger');
  const links = document.getElementById('navLinks');
  burger.addEventListener('click', () => links.classList.toggle('open'));
  links.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => links.classList.remove('open')));

  // Scroll reveal
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } });
  }, { threshold: 0.12 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach((el, i) => {
    el.style.transitionDelay = (Math.min(i % 6, 5) * 60) + 'ms';
    io.observe(el);
  });

  // Animated sales counter
  const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
  const target = 2450000;
  const reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  function rp(n){ return 'Rp ' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString('id-ID'); }
  if (reduce) { counter.textContent = rp(target); }
  else {
    let started = false;
    const cio = new IntersectionObserver((es) => {
      es.forEach(e => {
        if (e.isIntersecting && !started) {
          started = true;
          const dur = 1400, t0 = performance.now();
          (function tick(now){
            const p = Math.min((now - t0) / dur, 1);
            const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
            counter.textContent = rp(target * eased);
            if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
          })(t0);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.5 });
    cio.observe(counter);
  }
</script>
</body>
